column3: Close to the Hebrew; עַל־ עֲרָבִים (“on the poplars”) is rendered “Upon the willows.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְתוֹלָלֵינוּ (“our tormentors”) is rendered “those who plundered us,” and NKJV supplies “Saying.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “its skill.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to the sons of Edom” is rendered “against the sons of Edom.”
Close to the Hebrew; הַשְּׁדוּדָה (“devastated, destroyer”) is rendered “who are to be destroyed.”
